rows.grounds: prescriptive ritual action of embedding or planting
locative adverb referring to the previously indicated place
ritual objects to be fixed in place

items.question: What ritual action must be performed with pegs brought to the outside location?
premises: The pegs are to be brought outside.
The action prescribed is fixing or embedding them.
This fixing is to be done in that specified place.
items.inference: Therefore, after bringing the pegs outside, one should fix them there.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tatra depends on the preceding directional instructions.
items.plain_english: Having brought them outside, one should fix the pegs there.
